metadata.description: Claude plugins for Devino Solutions products. Each plugin wraps the product's remote MCP connector with workflow skills.

plugins.name: postify
plugins.description: Draft, schedule, and publish social posts from your Postify calendar.

plugins.name: dodomain
plugins.description: Pre-flight, connect, and verify customer domains from your doDomain team.

plugins.name: getitdone
plugins.description: Review, create, and update tasks in your GetItDone workspaces.

plugins.name: bioflow
plugins.description: Edit, publish, and measure your BioFlow link-in-bio pages.

plugins.name: sendly
plugins.description: Run your Sendly email workspace: contacts, campaigns, workflows, deliverability, and analytics.

plugins.name: shorty
plugins.description: Summarize and transcribe videos, audio, documents, and web pages with Shorty.

plugins.name: unotes
plugins.description: Search the uNotes study library and your own study data, read-only.

plugins.name: uptimely
plugins.description: Check monitors, incidents, alerts, and on-call in Uptimely, and run incident response with confirmation.

plugins.name: notifly
plugins.description: Read Notifly workflows, subscribers, and delivery history, and send a workflow with two-step confirmation.
